$comment: Analytics taxonomy — export family. Merged with its siblings by server/analytics.taxonomy(); see _envelope.json.

export_completed.$comment: THE North Star. Hooked at render_jobs.py where origin+job_id are in scope; DEFINED by the receipt write completing in lib/project.py — hook line is not definition line. `ordinal`/`first_export` are deliberately absent: the only local counter is the in-memory job dict, which empties on a backend restart, and both are exact at query time from min(timestamp) per install_id.
export_completed.question: Did a user actually produce a finished video?

export_artifact_opened.question: Do users review the finished work, or hand it off unwatched?

export_downloaded.$comment: The <a download> had NO handler at all — this row required adding one.
export_downloaded.question: Did the artifact actually leave the app?

export_became_stale.$comment: Emitted from the CONSUMER on the current true->false transition, not from lib/project.py's final_render_status — that runs inside list_assets, which the UI polls every 4s, and it is in lib/.
export_became_stale.question: How often do users edit after exporting? Decides re-export cues.

export_aborted_before_job.question: Why does export intent never become computation?

export_timed_out_in_ui.question: Does the UI give up while the work continues? Stream progress instead of polling.
